summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves and executes attacker-mutable code on install
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On every `npm install`, npm clones the default branch HEAD of that third-party GitHub repository and installs it, running any lifecycle scripts contained in whatever bytes the repo currently returns. Whoever controls RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node can push arbitrary code to that branch at any later time and every subsequent install of raiden-baileys will execute it with the installer's privileges. The dependency source is an off-registry, mutable, integrity-unchecked git ref, which is the install-time-rce fingerprint for an off-registry dependency source — the fetch happens on default install and no `scripts` block or shipped payload is required for the hole to be exploitable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
